notes: I moved the plateau's upper bound up to 116 (E10 shows 115.1 is still plateau, contradicting v2's 112 cap) and lowered it slightly to 100 (E8's 96.5 is not plateau). I also dropped the ad-hoc small-x branch and linear correction, since the plain cubic already fits the near-zero values reasonably and the corrections were causing errors (e.g. E10 x=-3.5 predicted -0.79 vs observed -70.56).
